name: Kaneshwar Sharma
title: Senior Backend Engineer
headline: Senior Software Engineer | Python & FastAPI | Go | MySQL & PostgreSQL | Microservices | AWS & GCP
summary: Backend-focused senior software engineer who builds Python (FastAPI) and Go REST APIs, event-driven microservices, and data pipelines on Linux, AWS, and GCP. At Spyne.ai, was promoted to SDE-II and team lead of 3 within 13 months, and shipped FastAPI APIs with API-key authentication for 50+ enterprise clients, JWT authentication for its web and mobile apps, and a Kafka pipeline processing 200K+ images/day. At Intract, a Web3 platform, built the backend for a multi-chain analytics launch that generated $600K+ in NFT mint revenue within 2 weeks. Writes unit tests against mocked dependencies (pytest, unittest.mock) behind CI coverage gates; also works in TypeScript, with early-career production React/Next.js experience.

experience.description: AI model-training work and a client placement with a Dubai-based company building a super app
achievements: Developed Go and PostgreSQL backend services integrating Uber into the client's super app (OAuth 2.0 account linking, fare estimates, and trip-status webhooks), so users could access Uber rides without leaving the app.
Built backend APIs that create standardized AI/ML training environments, with consistent data formatting and scalable ingestion pipelines.

experience.description: Web3 platform: multi-chain user analytics and wallet intelligence. Joined as consultant, converted to full-time.
achievements: Built the backend for Intract Rewind end-to-end: parallel fetchers plus a normalization/aggregation layer over 16 blockchain data sources that reconstructed each user's on-chain activity history behind an analytics API; the launch generated $600K+ in NFT mint revenue within 2 weeks.

Led the AWS-to-GCP migration, building the migration tooling in Python, and a multi-region rollout on autoscaling Managed Instance Groups behind a Global HTTP(S) Load Balancer; database indexing, query restructuring, caching, gzip compression, and instance right-sizing cut p95 response times 50% and monthly cloud spend 40%.

Built the serverless Go backend (API Gateway → Lambda → Kinesis stream processors → MongoDB) for a Telegram Mini App game serving ~5M users (40K+ daily active), with unit and integration tests run in Docker on GitHub Actions CI/CD.

Shipped a Web3 AI assistant turning MetaMask wallet activity, social profiles, and on-chain data into personalized insights: 5+ intent-routed agents, ChromaDB vector search with per-user data isolation, and SSE streaming.
Implemented JWT authentication with access and refresh tokens (cookie-based) for the Intract web app's backend APIs.
Automated infrastructure provisioning with Terraform and a Docker registry, with secrets managed in HashiCorp Vault.

experience.role: SDE-I → Senior Software Engineer (SDE-II) / Team Lead
experience.description: AI image-processing SaaS for automotive dealers and e-commerce platforms
achievements: Designed and maintained Python/FastAPI REST APIs for 50+ enterprise clients, with versioned endpoints and OpenAPI docs, and built their API-key authentication end-to-end.
Worked directly with enterprise clients, product managers, designers, and customer success to understand integration requirements, onboard clients onto the APIs, and resolve integration issues.
Promoted from SDE-I to SDE-II and team lead of 3 within 13 months (Apr 2022): conducted code reviews, mentored new hires, and led API architecture and MySQL schema design (Alembic migrations).

Engineered an event-driven microservices pipeline on Kafka (confluent-kafka) and AWS SQS processing 200K+ images/day, using Python multiprocessing to run pipeline workers in parallel across CPU cores.
Built a custom autoscaling controller that scaled worker pods on AWS EKS by Kafka consumer lag, throughput, and processing latency, cutting infrastructure cost 35%.
Added a Redis caching layer that reduced database load 60% and API latency from 500ms to under 100ms; set up Prometheus/Grafana monitoring and alerting for incident response.
Delivered the backend for Spyne's Android/iOS apps with real-time processing-status updates, and JWT authentication (access + refresh tokens) for its web and mobile apps.
Automated replication and monitoring of third-party API data streams, improving the reliability of marketing analytics.
Developed REST API integrations and web-scraping automation that reduced manual data collection and human error.
